title: Recompiled games list: fan native PC ports of console games (dataset)
description:
An open list of fan projects that turn console games into native PC programs instead of running them in an emulator: static recompilations (N64Recomp, XenonRecomp, ReXGlue, DolRecomp), decompilations, game-specific runtimes and single-game emulator forks. Each row has the game, console, project repository, method, status, PC platforms, dates and sources. JSON and CSV.

It is the data behind portedgames.com/recompiled-games, part of PortedGames, where every project's status is re-checked daily. No game files are included or linked.
